plugins.name: lucid
plugins.description: Manually curate native Claude Code memory stores — dedup and reconcile in place (git-versioned), while holding value-contradictions for your review instead of auto-resolving them.

plugins.name: devteam
plugins.description: Take one task to a reviewed pull request with area-owned agents — planner, builders, reviewer, QA, CI and code-review watchers — and a checkpoint at every step.

plugins.name: lavish-ext
plugins.description: Lavish extension: /lavish-ext:code-walkthrough turns a PR, branch, or diff into a plain-words, step-by-step walkthrough page (Overview, then Step 1..N with the code and why). Requires the lavish skill.
